facts.text: I am curious about how the Industrial Revolution affected the lives of workers in the industries that experienced growth.
I wonder whether we will experience a similar transformation to the Industrial Revolution in the near future.
I am excited to see what new technologies and advancements will come out in the future.
I think technology can be both exciting and daunting.
I am hopeful that we can use new technology for the greater good.
I want to tackle some of the world's biggest challenges using technology.
I hope that advancements in technology can bridge the gap in access to education and opportunities for people around the world.
I believe it is crucial to ensure that everyone has a fair chance to succeed.
